entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is VeloBot. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number, please?
Ugh, finally a real person. It's #VF12345. This thing is a piece of junk! The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. I want my money back.

Thank you. I see your order here. You purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 5th. I understand your frustration. At VeloFit, we want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. Let me check our return policy for smart watch returns.
Just tell me if I can return it or not. I don't have all day!
Okay, I see here that we have a 90 days return policy. As long as it's in like-new condition with all the original packaging, we can absolutely process a return for you.
90 days? Okay, that's what I wanted to hear! So, what do I do now?

Great! I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Simply repackage your VeloBand Pulse with all original components, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive the returned item, a refund will be issued to your original payment method. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to process. I can also see if a manager can expedite this, but I do not think that is necessary.
Perfect! That sounds easy enough. Thank you. Are you sure I don't need to wait any longer than 10 days for the refund?
Yes, allow 7-10 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. You've been a great help. Thanks so much!
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business at VeloFit. Have a great day!
